Moral acceptability here depends on respecting personal boundaries. People have the right to choose their social interactions. So the action in question is her wanting her own space and not wanting to go. The question is whether that's morally acceptable.

In most ethical frameworks, personal autonomy is important. If someone doesn't want to attend an event, especially one where they don't know the people, it's reasonable to want to opt out. So her wanting space isn't wrong; the issue is her family not respecting her boundaries.
